_comment: Peacock pack switches read by kubejs/server_scripts/*.js. Server-side; takes effect on /reload or restart. ladder=false disables recipe staging and place/hire gates (Blueprints still drop). sleepPercent: players (%) that must sleep to skip the night (-1 = vanilla rule untouched). bossBarScale: size of boss bars on screen, client-side (1 = vanilla). tabListOffset: where the player list (Tab) opens, client-side: "auto" lines it up with Jade's overlay below the compass bar; a number is a fixed shift in GUI pixels (0 = vanilla position).
